sources.entry: OpenCart - Shopping cart solution. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: OpenCart is a free, open source PHP ecommerce platform for online merchants to build and run an online store.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OpenCart as a free open source ecommerce platform providing a foundation for online stores. It points to installation and upgrade instructions that are included in the repository or download file, rather than giving them inline. It describes a Docker-based local development environment using make commands (init, build, up, down, logs, php, help). That environment runs Apache, PHP and MariaDB by default, with optional Adminer, Redis, Memcached and PostgreSQL services enabled through Compose profiles. The README also covers the PHP version switch, a four-part MAJOR.MINOR.FEATURE.PATCH versioning scheme, and the release process. It includes bug-reporting and contribution guidelines, with the full contributing guide held separately.
use_cases: set up a local ecommerce development environment
notable: Free and open source ecommerce platform licensed under GPLv3
Docker-based development environment with make commands and optional Compose profiles
Default PHP 8.4, switchable via PHP_VERSION in docker/.env.docker
Four-part MAJOR.MINOR.FEATURE.PATCH versioning with stated module-compatibility impact per level
caveats: Installation and upgrade steps are not in the README; they are in files included in the repository or download
Windows use needs WSL 2 for acceptable Docker file-system performance
Bug reports about third-party extensions or server configuration are closed without a reason, per the README
